description:
Cooperly helps founders, team leads, and people leaders see what is really happening inside a growing team before small people problems start slowing execution.
It connects team profiles, operating health checks, weekly Pulse signals, goals, hiring context, and team notes, and then turns that context into practical next steps.
Use Cooperly in ChatGPT to prepare better 1:1s, spot team bottlenecks, understand where pressure is building, improve team operating habits, and check candidate fit against the team you already have.
